title: Annual Leave Policy (Revised)
content: Effective January 1, 2026, this document supersedes the Annual Leave Policy v1. Full-time employees at Acme Corp now accrue 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, reflecting the company's updated benefits package. Leave accrues at a rate of 2.08 days per month. The two-week advance notice requirement for leave exceeding three consecutive days remains unchanged. The carry-over limit is increased to 10 days. Leave beyond the 10-day carry-over limit is forfeited at year end. The Q4 blackout period restrictions are removed under this revision. Leave requests continue to require manager approval.
